description: Animated vertical bar chart for finance metrics — revenue, AUM, quarterly results. Bars grow from 0 to their value over the asset's enter window, each on a short staggered spring; the numeric label above each bar counts from 0 to its value in lockstep so the figure visibly ticks up with the rise. Optional sort (asc|desc) lays the chart out small→large or large→small.

bars.description: Bars of { label, value, fillStyle? }. value drives bar height + count-up label.

value.description: Magnitude; sets bar height + count-up target

fillStyle.description: Per-bar override hex; falls back to styleOverride.barFill

typography.description: typography token (fontFamily + color feed labels; sizes derive from typography.fontSize)

easing.description: easing token for the bar grow spring

canvasFill.description: raw hex for the chart canvas

borderLine.description: raw hex for the canvas border; 'transparent' for none

axisPad.description: internal padding around the plot in px

axisLine.description: raw hex for the baseline (set 'transparent' to hide)

labelBandPad.description: px reserved under the plot for category labels

barFill.description: raw hex default bar fill (per-bar fillStyle wins)

valueFill.description: raw hex for the count-up value label

labelFill.description: raw hex for the category label

staggerFrames.description: target frames between bar starts; auto-shrunk to fit the timing budget

sortByValue.description: lay bars out small→large (asc) or large→small (desc). Omit to keep content order
